<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" /></noinclude><section begin=par74 />{{GHGmargin-letter|74|f}}
'''3.''' When {{GHGheb|text=א}} begins a syllable (consequently before afformatives which consist of or begin with a vowel, as well as before suffixes) it is necessarily a firm consonant, and the form then follows the analogy of the strong verb, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מָֽצְאָה}} ''māṣ<sup>e</sup>ʾā'', {{GHGheb|text=מָֽצְאוּ}}, &c. (in {{GHGterm|pause}} {{GHGheb|text=מָצָ֫אָה}}, {{GHGheb|text=מָצָ֫אוּ}}).

{{center|{{Small-caps|Remarks.}}}}

{{GHGmargin-letter|74|g}}
1. Verbs ''middle e'', like {{GHGheb|text=מָלֵא|translate=to be full}}, retain the {{GHGterm|Ṣere}} also in the other persons of the {{GHGterm|perfect}}, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מָלֵ֫אתִי}} ({{GHGheb|text=מְלָאוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Est|chapter=7|verse=5}} has {{GHGheb|text=־ָ}} owing to its transitive use; for {{GHGheb|text=יְרָאתֶם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=4|verse=24}} read with Ewald {{GHGheb|text=יִרְאָתָם}}). Instead of {{GHGheb|text=מָֽצְאָה}} the form {{GHGheb|text=קָרָאת|translate=she names}}, on the analogy of the {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}}-forms noticed in {{GHGpar|75|m}}, occurs in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=7|verse=14}} (from {{GHGheb|text=קָֽרְאַת}}, cf. {{GHGpar|44|f}}), and with a different meaning (''it befalls'') in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=31|verse=29}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=44|verse=23}}, in both places before {{GHGheb|text=א}}, and hence, probably, to avoid a hiatus (on the other hand, {{GHGheb|text=וְחָטָאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=5|verse=16}}, could only be the 2nd ''sing. masc.''; the text which is evidently corrupt should probably be emended to {{GHGheb|text=וְחָטָאתָ לְעַמֶּ֫ךָ}} with the LXX); in {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=נִפְלָאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=118|verse=23}}; in {{GHGterm|Hophʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=הֻבָאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=33|verse=11}}.—The 2nd ''fem. sing.'' is written {{GHGheb|text=קָרָאתְ}} by Baer, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gen|chapter=16|verse=11}}, &c., according to early MSS.

{{GHGmargin-letter|74|h}}
2. The ''infin. Qal'' occurs sometimes on the analogy of verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} ({{GHGheb|text=גְּלוֹת}}, &c., see {{GHGpar|75|nn}}) in the feminine form; so always {{GHGheb|text=מְלֹאת|translate=to fill}} (as distinguished from {{GHGheb|text=מְלֹא|translate=fullness}}), {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=8|verse=33}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=12|verse=4.6|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=25|verse=30|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=29|verse=10}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=5|verse=2}}, also written {{GHGheb|text=מְלֹאות}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=25|verse=12}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=20|verse=22}}, &c., and {{GHGheb|text=מְלוֹאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Est|chapter=1|verse=5}}. Cf. further, {{GHGheb|text=קְרֹאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=8|verse=1}}; {{GHGheb|text=שְׂנֹאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Pr|chapter=8|verse=13}}; before suffixes, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=33|verse=12}}, and likewise in ''Niph.'' {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=13|verse=4}}; also in {{GHGterm|Piʿēl}} {{GHGheb|text=לְמַלֹּאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=31|verse=5}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=35|verse=33|hidebook=1}}, or {{GHGheb|text=לְמַלֹּאות}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dn|chapter=9|verse=2}}, &c. {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}}; with suffix {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=21|verse=2}}.—On the (aramaïzing) ''infinitives'' {{GHGheb|text=מַשָּׂא}} and {{GHGheb|text=מַשְׂאוֹת}}, see {{GHGpar|45|e}}; on {{GHGheb|text=לִקְרַאת|translate=obviam}}, {{GHGpar|19|k}}.—{{GHGheb|text=בְּמֹצַֽאֲכֶם|translate=when ye find}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=32|verse=20}}, stands, according to {{GHGpar|93|q}}, for {{GHGheb|text=מָצְאֲכֶם}}. The tone of the lengthened {{GHGterm|imperative}} {{GHGheb|text=רְפָאָ֫ה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=41|verse=5}} as {{GHGterm|Mil<sup>e</sup>raʿ}} (before {{GHGheb|text=נַפְשִׁי}}) is to be explained on rhythmical grounds; cf. the analogous cases in {{GHGpar|72|s}}.—The 2nd ''fem. plur. imperative'' in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=1|verse=9}} has, according to ''Qimḥi'', the form {{GHGheb|text=מְצֵ֫אןָ}} and in verse 20 {{GHGheb|text=קְרֵ֫אןָ}}; on the other hand, the Mantua edition and Ginsburg, on good authority, read {{GHGheb|text=מְצֶאןָ}}, {{GHGheb|text=קְרֶאןָ}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|74|i}}
3. The {{GHGterm|participle fem.}} is commonly contracted, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=מֹצֵאת}} (for {{GHGheb|text=מֹצֶ֫אֶת}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=18|verse=22}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Est|chapter=2|verse=15}}; so {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=נִפְלֵאת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=30|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=5|verse=7}} (but {{GHGheb|text=נִשָּׂאָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=30|verse=25}}), and {{GHGterm|Hophʿal}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=38|verse=25}}; less frequent forms are {{GHGheb|text=מֽוֹצְאֵת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ct|chapter=8|verse=10}}; {{GHGheb|text=נֹשְׂאֵת}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=10|verse=22}} (cf. {{GHGpar|76|b}}, {{GHGheb|text=שְׂאֵת}} beside {{GHGheb|text=לָשֵׂאת}} as {{GHGterm|infinitive construct}} from {{GHGheb|text=נָשָׂא}}) and without {{GHGheb|text=א}} (see k) {{GHGheb|text=יוֹצֵת}} (from {{GHGheb|text=יָצָא}}) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=28|verse=57}}. In the forms {{GHGheb|text=חֹטִאים|translate=sinning}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=14|verse=33}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=99|verse=6}}; {{GHGheb|text=בֹּדָאם|translate=feigning them}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Neh|chapter=6|verse=8}}, the {{GHGheb|text=א}} is elided, and is only retained orthographically ({{GHGpar|23|c}}) after the retraction of its vowel; see the analogous cases in {{GHGpar|75|oo}}.—On the ''plur. masc. ptcp. Niph.'' cf. {{GHGpar|93|oo}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|74|k}}
4. Frequently an {{GHGheb|text=א}} which is quiescent is omitted in writing ({{GHGpar|23|f}}): (''a'') in the middle of the word, e.g. {{GHGheb|text=בָּ֫נוּ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=25|verse=8}}; {{GHGheb|text=מָצָ֫תִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=11|verse=11}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=1|verse=21}}; {{GHGheb|text=צָמֵ֫תִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=4|verse=19}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=32|verse=18}}. In the {{GHGterm|imperfect}} {{GHGheb|text=תִּשֶּׂ֫נָה}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=9|verse=17}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Zc|chapter=5|verse=9}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=1|verse=14}} (but the same form occurs with {{GHGterm|Yôdh}} pleonastic after the manner of verbs {{GHGheb|text=ל״ה}} in {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ez|chapter=23|verse=49}}, according to the common reading; cf. {{GHGpar|76|b}} and {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=50|verse=20}}); in {{GHGterm|Piʿēl}} {{GHGheb|text=אַחַטֶּ֫נָּה}} (after elision of the {{GHGheb|text=א}}, cf. {{GHGpar|75|oo}} ) {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=39}}; and also in {{GHGterm|Niphʿal}} {{GHGheb|text=נִטְמֵתֶם}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=11|verse=43}}; cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jos|chapter=2|verse=16}}. (''b'') at the end of the word; {{GHGheb|text=וַיָּבוֹ}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=12|verse=12}} {{GHGterm|K<sup>e</sup>thîbh}}; {{GHGterm|Hiphʿîl}} {{GHGheb|text=הֶֽחֱטִי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=13|verse=6}}, cf. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=53|verse=10}} ({{GHGheb|text=הֶֽחֱלִי}} for {{GHGheb|text=הֶֽחֱלִיא}} {{GHGterm|perfect Hiphʿîl}} of {{GHGheb|text=חָלָה}} formed<section end=par74 /><noinclude>
